parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps on its surface. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing continents, countries, and oceans. It can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around a fixed axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting base and arm structure of the globe, made of durable plastic, approximately 15 cm tall.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the rotating sphere, holding it in place while allowing free rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
